title_candidates: OpenAI's Patch the Planet focuses AI security on fixing, not just finding
summary: OpenAI and Trail of Bits launched Patch the Planet to help open-source maintainers validate, patch, test, and disclose security fixes with human review.

primary_source.title: Patch the Planet: a Daybreak initiative to support open source maintainers
primary_source.author: OpenAI
key_facts: OpenAI introduced Patch the Planet as a Daybreak initiative with Trail of Bits.
The initiative pairs AI-assisted security research with expert human review before findings reach maintainers.
Initial participants include cURL, NATS Server, pyca/cryptography, Sigstore, aiohttp, Go, freenginx, Python, and python.org.
Participating projects receive ChatGPT Pro, conditional Codex Security access, and API credits for development and maintainer workflows.

supporting_sources.title: Daybreak: Tools for securing every organization in the world

prerequisites: An open-source project you maintain or depend on

steps.instruction: Pick one dependency or repository that matters to your work.
Check whether it has a security policy, disclosure contact, and recent release activity.
Look for open security advisories, stale dependency alerts, or unreviewed vulnerability reports.
If you maintain the project, document how you want outside researchers to report and validate issues.
If you only depend on it, decide whether you need a fallback, patch window, or funding/support path for that dependency.
